description: This is a Java source test class for the ImplementationIdValidator, testing validation logic for ImplementationId objects in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: ImplementationIdValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for ImplementationIdValidator, extends BaseContextSensitiveTest to provide context for testing.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfImplementationIdIsNUll
methods.description: Tests that validate() throws an APIException when passed null arguments.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfImplementationIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation errors when ImplementationId's id is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes if description is null and required fields are set properly.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPassPhraseIsNull
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when passphrase is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfGivenEmptyImplementationIdObject
methods.description: Tests validation errors when creating a blank ImplementationId object.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfGivenACaretInTheImplementationIdCode
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the implementationId has a caret character (^).

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfGivenAPipeInTheImplementationIdCode
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the implementationId contains a pipe character (|).

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the name of the ImplementationId is null.
